answer: Require every agent identity to lock a stake behind a verifiable work kernel: before joining the mesa of traders, an agent must complete a costly, useful computation whose result is as hard and transparent as quartz, and post a bond that is slashed if the same operator is caught running duplicates. Creating one fake identity then costs real compute plus locked capital, while one honest agent pays only once, so a sybil flood becomes more expensive than any gain from it.
